input.quote: a. Client will pay TrueLink's fees for requested Hosting Services and Support Services pursuant to the schedule of charges set forth on Exhibits "A" and "B" attached hereto, (but not less than $____ per month for the Hosting Services and $____ per month for Support Services).
input.rationale: Section 5(a) imposes a minimum monthly fee floor on Client for both Hosting and Support Services regardless of usage, i.e. a take-or-pay commitment, and Section 6 expressly strips Client of documentation and dispute rights for those minimum fees. The term auto-renews for successive one-year periods (Section 13), so the floor recurs indefinitely, and the amounts are left blank. Client's at-will exit under Section 14 (effective the last day of the month following notice) mitigates but does not remove the commitment, and there is no true-up mechanism. We therefore delete the minimum and the related carve-outs to reach the preferred position (pay for usage/ordered services only), offering the 12-month, notice-reducible, trued-up floor as fallback.

proposal.summary: Delete the minimum monthly Hosting/Support fee floor and the related carve-outs from Client's documentation and dispute rights
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted the minimum monthly Hosting Services and Support Services fee floor so that we pay only for services we actually request, consistent with our position against take-or-pay commitments, and removed the related carve-outs so all charges remain subject to supporting documentation and dispute rights. If TrueLink needs a floor, we can accept one limited to the current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice and trued-up rather than penalised.
